description: This file contains a Java class `BlowFishCrypt` which implements symmetric encryption and decryption using Blowfish algorithm. It provides methods to encrypt/decrypt strings and byte arrays, handle secret keys, and includes a main method to generate and test cryptographic keys.

classes.name: BlowFishCrypt
classes.description: A utility class for Blowfish encryption and decryption, supporting key generation, key loading from file, and encryption of strings and byte arrays.

methods.description: Constructor to create a `BlowFishCrypt` instance by loading a secret key from a file.
